title: What Does a Cosine of 0.8 Mean? Monotone Calibration of Embedding Similarity
abstract: arXiv:2601.16907v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Text embedding models turn sentences into vectors, and the cosine between two vectors is the usual measure of their similarity. Search, semantic caching and deduplication often accept a pair when this cosine reaches a fixed threshold. When people judge one pair of sentences more similar than another, the cosine usually agrees, but its value means different things for different models, because each model packs its scores into its own narrow range. The same threshold can therefore keep most pairs with one model and few with another.   We propose to calibrate the score instead of changing the model. An increasing function fitted on sentence pairs rated by people translates the cosine of each model into the human rating scale and never reverses the order of two pairs. translated_title: 余弦值0.8到底意味着什么？嵌入相似度的单调校准
translated_abstract: 文本嵌入模型将句子转换为向量，两个向量之间的余弦值是衡量其相似度的常用标准。搜索、语义缓存和去重等任务通常在余弦值达到固定阈值时接受一对文本。当人们判断某一对句子比另一对更相似时，余弦值通常能给出一致的方向，但其数值对于不同模型却有不同的含义，因为每个模型会将其分数压缩到各自狭窄的取值范围内。因此，同一个阈值可能在某个模型下保留大多数文本对，而在另一个模型下只保留少数文本对。我们提出对分数进行校准，而不是修改模型本身。一个在由人工评分的句子对上拟合的递增函数，可以将每个模型的余弦值转换到人类评分量表上，并且从不颠倒两个文本对的相对顺序。我们为六个模型拟合了三种这样的函数，从简单的S形曲线到自由的阶梯函数。在新文本对上，校准后的分数与人类评分保持一致，并且……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一种单调校准方法，通过在人工评分句子对上拟合递增函数，将不同嵌入模型的余弦相似度分数统一转换到人类评分量表，使同一阈值在不同模型间具有一致含义且不改变文本对的相对顺序。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a monotone calibration method that maps the cosine similarity scores of different embedding models onto a unified human rating scale using increasing functions fitted on human-rated sentence pairs, making a fixed threshold consistent across models without reversing pair orderings.
